full_judgment: 9. Mr JN Deb, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners, seeks to impeach the judgments and decrees of the Courts below on the three-fold arguments. Firstly, the plaintiffs failed to prove their own case and the learned Judges of the Courts below shifted the burden of proof upon the defendants which is not at all permissible under law.
